FRAGMENT slice: one gauge tile (pa-kpi-gauge) of the comparison-gauges design, the sub-component kpi_gauge_list/1 defers through its inner_block slot. Maps the tile's own features: the sentiment variant (→ pa-kpi-gauge--*, dasherized idempotently), the head label/value text (label_text / value_text → __num), the prefix/unit affixes (prefix_text / unit_text → __unit spans), the inline bar fill width (bar_percent → style="width: N%" on __fill, :integer), the optional target-tick position (tick_position → inline --pa-kpi-gauge-tick-pos on __bar, folded into bar_style only when present so no empty style attribute), and the right scale label (scale_end_text; scale_start_text keeps its 'LIVE'-free default '0'). The detail popover (Kpi.kpi_detail) is a separate sub-component (kpi-detail fixture) only rendered when detail props are set — none here.
